evidence.t: Burn from 2023 (fire VA1638), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SE facing slope, 25 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Crag Creek 100 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Thompson, Cariboo and Okanagan Alpines. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-82/24.

plan: Drive: from Stuie, about 76 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.7383, -126.67174, pull off on an unnamed paved road. Map links below.
Walk: 15 km E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 3,123 m, about 604 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 220 m SW of the spot at 656 m (52.69268, -126.46918). Water: Crag Creek 20 m NW (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-9, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
